strategies.title: ReUI Integration
strategies.content: ReUI registered as on-demand remote MCP server at https://mcp.reui.io with official skill in .agents/skills/reui and /reui workflow.

strategies.title: CI Pipefail Enforcement
strategies.content: Always set -e -o pipefail in CI bash scripts when piping build tools (flutter build, gradle) to tee to prevent masked failures and missing artifact distribution errors.

strategies.title: End-to-End Ingestion Context & Verification Pattern
strategies.content: Preserve appSource, rawPayload, and counterpartyLast4 from Android broadcast receivers and OCR parser all the way through TransactionModel and ledger UI. Ensure AutoImportService category prediction is direction-aware (isIncome=true predicts salary/refunds/investments, avoiding expense fallbacks). Prevent duplicates in batch SMS scanners via refId and fuzzy composite match.
